Name: Saloon adds drinks
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Saloon Expanded Menu
Requirements: Content Patcher 

Adds additional drinks to Saloon menu.
Wine 
Pale Ale 
Mead 
Green Tea 
Juice 
Triple Shot Espresso 
Cranberry Candy 
Milk 
JoJa Cola 

After Ginger Island Resort is completed, adds
Pina Colada 
Gold Star Mango Wine 
Ginger Ale 

[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Please let me know and link the translation to this mod.
Chinese (zh.json) added by CNSCZJ
Russian added by Bromgek

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract [b]Saloon adds Drinks [/b]into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

I hope you enjoy this mod. You might also like
